business_summary: Ester Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of polyester films in India and internationally. It operates through Polyester chips and films; and Specialty Polymers segments. The company offers polyester films, including lidding and sealable films, barrier films, PCR and sustainable films, label films, and decorative, visual and brand enhancement films. It also provides textile and industrial polymers, such as flame-retardant, recycled flame-retardant, high-tenacity, and hot-melt technical polymers; low melt adhesive, polyester, resin, crystalline polymer, high IV LMC polymer, and co-polyester coating polymer; co-polyester coating, packaging film, high-temperature packaging, high-seal film, high-barrier, extrusion coating, and metal bonding polymer; thermoforming and sheet polymers; and stain resistant, easy-dyeable, cationic-dyeable polymer, dye-enhancing masterbatch, optical-clarity masterbatch, and silica-based additive. In addition, the company offers bottle grade chips, film/sheet grade chips, and textile grade chips. It serves the food packaging, beverage packaging, home and personal care, industrial packaging, construction, identification and security, automotive, electrical and electronics, appliance, consumer and industrial goods, carpet, and textile industry markets. It also exports its products. The company was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in Gurugram, India. Ester Industries Limited is a subsidiary of Wilemina Finance Corporation.
